title: Wellness Resources | MY Project USA

meta.description: Find trusted wellness resources for youth, parents, and community members, including mental health counseling, Muslim mental health support, substance use treatment, recovery programs, and crisis resources in Columbus, Ohio and online.
meta.ogDescription: Find trusted wellness resources for youth, parents, and community members, including mental health counseling, Muslim mental health support, substance use treatment, recovery programs, and crisis resources in Columbus, Ohio and online.

items.html:
Finding support can be an important step toward wellness. Below are mental health, counseling, substance use, recovery, and Muslim community resources available locally and online.

​

If you or someone you know needs immediate help:
Call or text 988 — Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. In an emergency, call 911.

​

Find Resources

  • Mental Health & Counseling — Columbus

  • Muslim Mental Health & Wellness Support

  • Substance Use & Addiction Treatment

  • Recovery & Peer Support​

​

Mental Health & Counseling — Columbus

 

  • Syntero   Phone: 614-889-5722

  • ​North Community Counseling Centers Phone: 614-267-7003​

  • Heart of Ohio Family Health Phone: 614-235-5555

  • ​PrimaryOne Health Phone: 614-645-2700 

  • ​Concord Counseling Services Phone: 614-882-9338

  • ​OhioGuidestone Phone: 888-522-9174 

  • ​OSU Harding Behavioral Health

    • Outpatient Psychiatry: 614-293-9600   

    • Partial Hospitalization / Intensive Outpatient: 614-293-9560

​​

Muslim Mental Health & Wellness Support
​

  • Naseeha Mental Health Free support for teens and young adults, including access to peer counselors.

  • Ruh Care Online directory for finding Muslim therapists.

  • Khalil Center Muslim mental health professionals and faith-integrated mental health services.

  • Islamestic — I Am Feeling Islamic emotional wellness resources and du'as connected to different emotions.

​

Substance Use & Addiction Treatment

 

  • Maryhaven Phone: 614-445-8131

  • BrightView Health Phone: 1-833-510-HELP

  • Millati Islami  Muslim-focused 12-step recovery support.  

  • SMART Recovery Online and local recovery support using a CBT-based approach.  

  • Amethyst Women-focused addiction treatment Phone: 614-242-1284

  • The Refuge Phone: 614-991-0131

  • The Woods at Parkside Phone: 614-471-2552   

  • Nationwide Children's Hospital — Medication Assisted Treatment Addiction Program Phone: 614-355-8614   

  • Talbot Hall — The Ohio State University Phone: 614-257-3760 

  • The Recovery Village  

​

Recovery & Peer Support

 

  • Alcoholics Anonymous — Central Ohio Phone: 614-253-8501

  • Alcoholics Anonymous — National Phone: 212-870-3400

  • Al-Anon — Central Ohio Phone: 614-547-1550

  • Narcotics Anonymous — Central Ohio Phone: 614-252-1700

  • SMART Recovery  PHONE NUMBER:???

  • The Phoenix  Activity-based, in-person and virtual recovery community. 

  • Women for Sobriety 

  • LifeRing Secular Recovery  

  • ​​Moderation Management  

  • Secular Organizations for Sobriety  

​

Need immediate help?


Call or text 988 for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. In an emergency, call 911.

​

MY Project USA provides these links as community resources. Inclusion on this page does not constitute an endorsement of any individual provider or organization. Please contact providers directly regarding services, eligibility, insurance, costs, and availability.

​
